quote: among younger children or those with fewer digital
es: Los niños más pequeños o con menos habilidades digitales y críticas pueden ser más propensos a confiar en los resultados de la IA generativa, por su carácter opaco, rápido y personalizado.
caveat: Entrevistas cualitativas a 244 jóvenes de 13–17 años en 15 países europeos (solo usuarios al menos ocasionales); interpretación de las autoras, no cuantificada. Hecho como afirmación interpretativa de las autoras; la muestra cualitativa son 13–17 años.
en: Younger children, or those with fewer digital and critical skills, may be more likely to trust the outputs of generative AI, owing to its opaque, fast and personalized nature.
caveat_en: Qualitative interviews with 244 young people aged 13–17 in 15 European countries (only at least occasional users); authors' interpretation, not quantified. Stated as an interpretive claim by the authors; the qualitative sample is aged 13–17.

quote: sources. These accounts point to a more cautious
es: Los niños con más habilidades describen prácticas de verificación y contraste (cotejar las respuestas de la IA con otras fuentes), que apuntan a una confianza más cautelosa y condicionada.
caveat: Entrevistas cualitativas a 244 jóvenes de 13–17 años en 15 países europeos (solo usuarios al menos ocasionales); interpretación de las autoras, no cuantificada.
en: Children with greater skills describe verification and cross-checking practices (comparing AI answers with other sources), which point to a more cautious, conditional trust.
caveat_en: Qualitative interviews with 244 young people aged 13–17 in 15 European countries (only at least occasional users); authors' interpretation, not quantified.

quote: they would prefer to have guidance on how to use it
es: Algunos niños delegan por completo sus tareas a GenAI (copiar y pegar), mientras otros la consideran muy útil y preferirían recibir orientación sobre cómo usarla adecuadamente en lugar de que se la restrinja o prohíba.
caveat: Entrevistas cualitativas a 244 jóvenes de 13–17 años en 15 países europeos (solo usuarios al menos ocasionales); interpretación de las autoras, no cuantificada.
en: Some children delegate their tasks entirely to GenAI (copy and paste), while others find it very useful and would prefer to receive guidance on how to use it appropriately rather than having it restricted or banned.
caveat_en: Qualitative interviews with 244 young people aged 13–17 in 15 European countries (only at least occasional users); authors' interpretation, not quantified.

quote: treatment to be unfair and asked for more guidelines
es: Los niños consideraron injusto el trato dispar de los docentes ante el uso de GenAI (unos sancionados, otros no) y pidieron más directrices sobre cómo usarla correctamente en contexto académico.
caveat: Entrevistas cualitativas a 244 jóvenes de 13–17 años en 15 países europeos (solo usuarios al menos ocasionales); interpretación de las autoras, no cuantificada.
en: Children considered it unfair that teachers treated GenAI use unevenly (some students penalized, others not) and asked for more guidelines on how to use it correctly in academic contexts.
caveat_en: Qualitative interviews with 244 young people aged 13–17 in 15 European countries (only at least occasional users); authors' interpretation, not quantified.

quote: schools do not yet have formal rules regarding the use
es: La mayoría de los colegios aún no tiene normas formales sobre el uso de GenAI; solo el 6% de los encuestados dice no usarla porque no está permitida en su colegio (de 9% en Italia a 3% en Estonia).
caveat: Base de la Tabla 7: no usuarios de cinco países (EE, FI, HR, IT, NO; n=1,438); la rotulación de base de las figuras es inconsistente. Autoinforme.

en: Most schools do not yet have formal rules on GenAI use; only 6% of respondents say they do not use it because it is not allowed at their school (from 9% in Italy to 3% in Estonia).
caveat_en: Base of Table 7: non-users in five countries (EE, FI, HR, IT, NO; n=1,438); the labelling of the bases in the figures is inconsistent. Self-reported.

quote: such rules. It seemed that decisions were largely left to
es: Pocos niños hablaron de reglas oficiales en su colegio; las decisiones parecen quedar en gran medida a discreción de cada docente, con unos que prohíben y otros que permiten.
caveat: Entrevistas cualitativas a 244 jóvenes de 13–17 años en 15 países europeos (solo usuarios al menos ocasionales); interpretación de las autoras, no cuantificada.
en: Few children mentioned official rules at their school; decisions appear to be left largely to the discretion of each teacher, with some prohibiting and others permitting.
caveat_en: Qualitative interviews with 244 young people aged 13–17 in 15 European countries (only at least occasional users); authors' interpretation, not quantified.

en: Even when some children say their parents have placed restrictions on them, this does not appear to stop them from using GenAI anyway.
caveat_en: Three countries (EE, NO, PL); restrictions as perceived by the children and self-reported use.

quote: Very few of the children we interviewed discussed
es: Muy pocos niños entrevistados hablaron de reglas estrictas de sus padres sobre el uso de GenAI; algunos padres prohibían el uso, otros advertían contra la dependencia excesiva (por riesgo de pérdida de habilidades) o por razones éticas, como considerarlo trampa.
caveat: Entrevistas cualitativas a 244 jóvenes de 13–17 años en 15 países europeos (solo usuarios al menos ocasionales); interpretación de las autoras, no cuantificada.
en: Very few interviewed children spoke of strict parental rules on GenAI use; some parents prohibited its use, others warned against excessive reliance (because of the risk of skill loss) or on ethical grounds, such as considering it cheating.
caveat_en: Qualitative interviews with 244 young people aged 13–17 in 15 European countries (only at least occasional users); authors' interpretation, not quantified.

quote: unaware of the various ways in which their
es: Hay grandes diferencias entre los padres: algunos tienen interés personal o profesional en la tecnología y pueden apoyar a sus hijos adolescentes, mientras que otros desconocen en gran medida las maneras en que sus hijos usan GenAI, lo que es especialmente importante para el uso de apoyo en salud mental.
caveat: Entrevistas cualitativas a 244 jóvenes de 13–17 años en 15 países europeos (solo usuarios al menos ocasionales); interpretación de las autoras, no cuantificada.
en: There are large differences among parents: some have a personal or professional interest in the technology and can support their adolescent children, while others are largely unaware of the ways their children use GenAI, which is especially important for mental health support use.
caveat_en: Qualitative interviews with 244 young people aged 13–17 in 15 European countries (only at least occasional users); authors' interpretation, not quantified.

quote: that the greatest risk of GenAI is to replace them,
es: Los entrevistados lamentan que el mayor riesgo de GenAI sea reemplazarlos, volviéndolos más perezosos e incapaces de realizar tareas básicas como escribir ensayos; temen que su desempeño académico empeore.
caveat: Entrevistas cualitativas a 244 jóvenes de 13–17 años en 15 países europeos (solo usuarios al menos ocasionales); interpretación de las autoras, no cuantificada. Percepciones de los jóvenes, no medición de deterioro real del aprendizaje.
en: Interviewees lament that the greatest risk of GenAI is that it replaces them, making them lazier and unable to perform basic tasks such as writing essays; they fear their academic performance will worsen.
caveat_en: Qualitative interviews with 244 young people aged 13–17 in 15 European countries (only at least occasional users); authors' interpretation, not quantified. Young people's perceptions, not a measurement of actual learning deterioration.

caveat: Base: no usuarios de cinco países (EE, FI, HR, IT, NO; n=1,438); contradicción reconocida entre cuestionario y entrevistas por distinto reclutamiento.

caveat_en: Base: non-users in five countries (EE, FI, HR, IT, NO; n=1,438); acknowledged contradiction between questionnaire and interviews owing to different recruitment.

quote: interviewees also refer to the opaque mechanisms and
es: Además de la simulación persuasiva de conversación humana y de la adulación (la tendencia incorporada de los chatbots a no contradecir al usuario, que genera sesgo de confirmación por diseño), los entrevistados mencionan los mecanismos opacos y los modelos de negocio de GenAI como razón para desconfiar.
caveat: Entrevistas cualitativas a 244 jóvenes de 13–17 años en 15 países europeos (solo usuarios al menos ocasionales); interpretación de las autoras, no cuantificada. La adulación (sycophancy) es un concepto de las autoras; no se midió en la encuesta.
en: Besides the persuasive simulation of human conversation and sycophancy (chatbots' built-in tendency not to contradict the user, which creates confirmation bias by design), interviewees mention GenAI's opaque mechanisms and business models as reasons for distrust.
caveat_en: Qualitative interviews with 244 young people aged 13–17 in 15 European countries (only at least occasional users); authors' interpretation, not quantified. Sycophancy is a concept used by the authors; it was not measured in the survey.

quote: says something wrong, it’d be really hard to tell unless
es: Un entrevistado señala que las respuestas del chatbot son tan convincentes que, aunque diga algo erróneo, es muy difícil notarlo sin verificar por cuenta propia.
caveat: Entrevistas cualitativas a 244 jóvenes de 13–17 años en 15 países europeos (solo usuarios al menos ocasionales); interpretación de las autoras, no cuantificada. Testimonio individual de un joven; ilustrativo.
en: One interviewee notes that chatbot answers are so convincing that, even when the chatbot says something wrong, it is very hard to notice without checking independently.
caveat_en: Qualitative interviews with 244 young people aged 13–17 in 15 European countries (only at least occasional users); authors' interpretation, not quantified. Individual testimony from one young person; illustrative.

quote: One in ten respondents – but nearly two in ten in Italy –
es: Uno de cada diez no usuarios (casi dos de cada diez en Italia) dice no usar GenAI por preocupación por la privacidad y por compartir información con ella.

quote: could be unsafe and that they were not clear as to how
es: Muchos niños saben que compartir información personal privada con chatbots puede ser inseguro y no tienen claro cómo se procesan y comparten luego los datos.
caveat: Entrevistas cualitativas a 244 jóvenes de 13–17 años en 15 países europeos (solo usuarios al menos ocasionales); interpretación de las autoras, no cuantificada.
en: Many children know that sharing private personal information with chatbots may be unsafe and are unclear about how the data are subsequently processed and shared.
caveat_en: Qualitative interviews with 244 young people aged 13–17 in 15 European countries (only at least occasional users); authors' interpretation, not quantified.

quote: children mentioned they would not share private medical
es: Muchos niños dijeron que no compartirían información médica privada con chatbots; una parte, sin embargo, no parecía consciente ni preocupada por tales riesgos.
caveat: Entrevistas cualitativas a 244 jóvenes de 13–17 años en 15 países europeos (solo usuarios al menos ocasionales); interpretación de las autoras, no cuantificada.
en: Many children said they would not share private medical information with chatbots; some, however, did not seem aware of or concerned about such risks.
caveat_en: Qualitative interviews with 244 young people aged 13–17 in 15 European countries (only at least occasional users); authors' interpretation, not quantified.

quote: malicious purposes, for the most part, they had not
es: Los niños sabían que GenAI puede usarse con fines maliciosos (deepfakes, ciberacoso), pero en su mayoría no habían vivido el problema; pocos hablaron de haber visto ciberacoso con deepfakes.
caveat: Entrevistas cualitativas a 244 jóvenes de 13–17 años en 15 países europeos (solo usuarios al menos ocasionales); interpretación de las autoras, no cuantificada.
en: Children knew that GenAI can be used for malicious purposes (deepfakes, cyberbullying), but most had not experienced the problem; few spoke of having seen cyberbullying with deepfakes.
caveat_en: Qualitative interviews with 244 young people aged 13–17 in 15 European countries (only at least occasional users); authors' interpretation, not quantified.

quote: were worried about fake pictures and untrue stories
es: Se preguntó a los niños si les preocupan las imágenes falsas y las historias falsas creadas con aplicaciones (que podrían causar ciberacoso, odio o desinformación); en promedio 23% está algo de acuerdo y 13% muy de acuerdo.
caveat: Encuesta escolar EU Kids Online 2025 en 17 países europeos (9–16 años); autoinforme, transversal (no causal); no generalizable fuera de Europa. Pregunta sobre 'nuevas tecnologías' (IA generativa, juguetes interactivos, robots).

caveat: Encuesta escolar EU Kids Online 2025 en 17 países europeos (9–16 años); autoinforme, transversal (no causal); no generalizable fuera de Europa. Diferencias por género relativamente pequeñas.
en: Girls, younger children and those of lower self-perceived SES tend more to see new technologies as problematic because of fake images and disinformation.
caveat_en: EU Kids Online 2025 school survey in 17 European countries (ages 9–16); self-reported, cross-sectional (not causal); not generalizable outside Europe. Gender differences are relatively small.

caveat_en: Subsample from four countries (Estonia, Finland, Norway, Poland) of past-month users; self-reported; not representative of Europe. The executive summary (p.3) gives slightly different figures (30% mixed, 37% no opinion): internal discrepancy.

quote: Explainability in educational AI refers to making the outputs of an AI system, its predictions, recommendations or classifications understandable to the people affected by them
es: Definición: explicabilidad en IA educativa es hacer comprensibles para las personas afectadas las salidas, predicciones, recomendaciones o clasificaciones de un sistema de IA, mostrando cómo se generaron y con qué base.
caveat: El propio texto indica que las definiciones del campo no están estandarizadas.
en: Definition: explainability in educational AI means making the outputs, predictions, recommendations or classifications of an AI system understandable to the people affected, showing how and on what basis they were generated.
caveat_en: The text itself notes that definitions in the field are not standardized.

quote: Definitions in the field remain unstandardized. Explainability is increasingly understood to be not only a technical property of a model
es: Las definiciones de explicabilidad en el campo siguen sin estandarizarse; se entiende cada vez más como requisito pedagógico y ético, no solo técnico.
en: Definitions of explainability in the field remain unstandardized; it is increasingly understood as a pedagogical and ethical requirement, not merely a technical one.

quote: the right to explanation should be understood as an emerging procedural safeguard for the protection of the right to education in AI-mediated environments
es: El derecho a explicación debe entenderse como una salvaguarda procesal emergente para proteger el derecho a la educación en entornos mediados por IA.
en: The right to explanation should be understood as an emerging procedural safeguard to protect the right to education in AI-mediated environments.

quote: provides an implicit legal and normative foundation for a right to explanation through its emphasis on participation, access to information and developmental support
es: La Convención sobre los Derechos del Niño da un fundamento implícito al derecho a explicación (participación, acceso a información, apoyo al desarrollo; arts. 5, 12, 17, 29), de acuerdo con las capacidades en evolución de la niñez.
age_note: se refiere a 'children' y sus 'evolving capacities', sin edades
caveat: La explicación no se plantea como derecho autónomo, sino como esencial para garantizar otros derechos.
en: The Convention on the Rights of the Child provides an implicit foundation for the right to explanation (participation, access to information, support for development; arts. 5, 12, 17, 29), in line with children's evolving capacities.
caveat_en: Explanation is not framed as a stand-alone right, but as essential to guaranteeing other rights.
age_note_en: refers to 'children' and their 'evolving capacities', without ages

quote: Article 22 establishes a right not to be subject to decisions based solely on automated processing when these have legal or similarly significant effects.
es: En el RGPD de la UE, el art. 22 establece el derecho a no ser objeto de decisiones basadas únicamente en tratamiento automatizado con efectos jurídicos o significativos; los arts. 13-15 exigen 'información significativa sobre la lógica aplicada'.
caveat: Normativa de la UE; no aplica directamente en Costa Rica.
en: Under the EU GDPR, art. 22 establishes the right not to be subject to decisions based solely on automated processing with legal or similarly significant effects; arts. 13-15 require 'meaningful information about the logic involved'.
caveat_en: EU legislation; does not apply directly in Costa Rica.

quote: While AI systems may assist in decision-making, they cannot replace ultimate human responsibility.
es: La IA puede asistir decisiones, pero no sustituye la responsabilidad humana última; educadores e instituciones deben poder intervenir y cambiar decisiones de IA que afecten trayectorias académicas.
en: AI can assist decisions, but it does not replace ultimate human responsibility; educators and institutions must be able to intervene in and change AI decisions that affect academic trajectories.

quote: AI systems can reproduce and reinforce existing prejudices and stereotypes embedded in training data, potentially exacerbating educational disparities.
es: Los sistemas de IA pueden reproducir y reforzar prejuicios presentes en sus datos de entrenamiento y agravar brechas educativas; sin transparencia es casi imposible detectar patrones discriminatorios.
en: AI systems can reproduce and reinforce biases present in their training data and aggravate educational gaps; without transparency, it is almost impossible to detect discriminatory patterns.

quote: Learners, parents and educators should be fully informed whenever decisions such as grading, placement or behavioural predictions are made or supported by AI.
es: Estudiantes, familias y docentes deben ser informados cuando la IA toma o apoya decisiones como calificación, ubicación o predicciones de conducta, poder pedir explicaciones claras y acceder a revisión humana.
en: Students, families and teachers must be informed when AI makes or supports decisions such as grading, placement or behavior predictions, be able to request clear explanations and have access to human review.

quote: Systems that monitor or assess student abilities must meet high standards of explainability, to prevent harmful effects on learning or cognitive development.
es: Los sistemas que monitorean o evalúan capacidades estudiantiles deben cumplir altos estándares de explicabilidad; la regulación debe gobernar cómo se recolectan, procesan y comparten los datos del estudiantado y evitar su uso comercial sin autorización.
en: Systems that monitor or assess student capabilities must meet high standards of explainability; regulation must govern how student data are collected, processed and shared and prevent their commercial use without authorization.

quote: Procurement is the key point at which an education system can make explainability a condition of adoption.
es: La compra es el momento clave para exigir explicabilidad: las autoridades deben pedir a los proveedores que revelen la base de sus decisiones antes de adquirir el sistema, no después de su despliegue.
en: Procurement is the key moment to demand explainability: authorities should require providers to disclose the basis of their decisions before acquiring the system, not after its deployment.

quote: Ministries, school leaders, teachers, inspectors and regulators need the knowledge, skills and resources to evaluate AI systems critically

en: Ministries, school leaders, teachers, inspectors and regulators need knowledge and resources to critically evaluate AI systems and interpret their outputs; investing in AI literacy for educators, students and the public is recommended.

en: In many systems, devices are provided mainly through shared resources (labs) and classroom access is more limited; connectivity is not always stable and technical support is often insufficient (ICILS 2023).
caveat_en: Based on questionnaires to ICT coordinators (ICILS 2023); describes availability, not use or learning.

quote: most common in areas related to operational safeguards, particularly the regulation of digital
es: Las normas vinculantes son más frecuentes en salvaguardas operativas (regulación del uso de dispositivos, ciberseguridad y protección de datos); los aspectos pedagógicos, la participación de las familias y la colaboración externa se abordan más con recomendaciones no vinculantes.
caveat: Describe políticas nacionales (Eurydice, 38 sistemas); no evalúa efectos en estudiantes.
en: Binding rules are more frequent for operational safeguards (regulation of device use, cybersecurity and data protection); pedagogical aspects, family involvement and external collaboration are addressed more through non-binding recommendations.
caveat_en: Describes national policies (Eurydice, 38 systems); does not assess effects on students.
age_note_en: ISCED 24 (lower secondary; focus of the report)

quote: education systems (29 out of 38) have a dedicated
es: Además del enfoque transversal, 29 de 38 sistemas tienen una asignatura específica de competencias digitales en secundaria baja (casi todos incluyen la competencia digital en el currículo de ese nivel).
caveat: Describe políticas nacionales (Eurydice, 38 sistemas); no evalúa efectos en estudiantes.

figure.population: sistemas con asignatura dedicada a competencias digitales (secundaria baja)

en: In addition to the cross-curricular approach, 29 of 38 systems have a dedicated digital competence subject in lower secondary (almost all include digital competence in the curriculum at that level).
caveat_en: Describes national policies (Eurydice, 38 systems); does not assess effects on students.
age_note_en: ISCED 24 (lower secondary; focus of the report)

figure_en.population: systems with a dedicated digital competence subject (lower secondary)

quote: separate subject is compulsory for all students in 25 education systems. Eight of them offer also a
es: La asignatura separada de competencia digital es obligatoria para todo el alumnado en 25 sistemas; ocho de ellos ofrecen además una asignatura optativa.
caveat: Describe políticas nacionales (Eurydice, 38 sistemas); no evalúa efectos en estudiantes.

figure.population: sistemas con asignatura de competencia digital obligatoria

en: The separate digital competence subject is compulsory for all students in 25 systems; eight of them also offer an optional subject.
caveat_en: Describes national policies (Eurydice, 38 systems); does not assess effects on students.
age_note_en: ISCED 24 (lower secondary; focus of the report)

figure_en.population: systems with a compulsory digital competence subject

quote: competence for all students starts at the primary
es: En casi todos los sistemas donde las autoridades centrales fijan el punto de partida de la educación digital obligatoria, la instrucción en competencia digital para todo el alumnado comienza en primaria.
caveat: Describe políticas nacionales (Eurydice, 38 sistemas); no evalúa efectos en estudiantes.
en: In almost all systems where central authorities set the starting point of compulsory digital education, instruction in digital competence for all students begins in primary school.
caveat_en: Describes national policies (Eurydice, 38 systems); does not assess effects on students.

quote: In 18 education systems, this is done as early as in
es: Entre los sistemas que fijan el inicio obligatorio en primaria, 18 lo hacen desde el primer grado; en ocho el inicio se retrasa varios grados dentro de primaria (grado 3, 4 o 5).
caveat: Describe políticas nacionales (Eurydice, 38 sistemas); no evalúa efectos en estudiantes.

figure.population: sistemas con enseñanza obligatoria de competencia digital desde grado 1 de primaria

en: Among the systems that set the compulsory start in primary school, 18 do so from the first grade; in eight, the start is delayed by several grades within primary (grade 3, 4 or 5).
caveat_en: Describes national policies (Eurydice, 38 systems); does not assess effects on students.

figure_en.population: systems with compulsory digital competence teaching from grade 1 of primary

quote: mix are significantly lower than those of their peers
es: Las competencias digitales del alumnado de escuelas con composición socioeconómica más desfavorecida son significativamente menores que las de escuelas más aventajadas en casi todos los países europeos, y la brecha no se explica solo por el acceso a recursos digitales.
caveat: Asociación observada en ICILS 2023; no establece causalidad.
en: The digital competences of students in schools with a more disadvantaged socioeconomic composition are significantly lower than those in more advantaged schools in almost all European countries, and the gap is not explained by access to digital resources alone.
caveat_en: Association observed in ICILS 2023; does not establish causality.

quote: the internet at all, or to experience internet drops
es: En casi todos los sistemas europeos participantes, el alumnado de contextos socioeconómicos bajos (proxy: 0–25 libros en casa) tiene significativamente menos probabilidad de contar con buena conexión a internet en casa; la brecha es máxima en Rumanía (20,2 pp).
caveat: Proxy socioeconómico (libros en casa); datos ICILS 2023.

figure.population: brecha en problemas de conexión en casa entre estudiantes con 0–25 y 26+ libros (Rumanía, máximo)

en: In almost all participating European systems, students from low socioeconomic backgrounds (proxy: 0–25 books at home) are significantly less likely to have a good internet connection at home; the gap is largest in Romania (20.2 pp).
caveat_en: Socioeconomic proxy (books at home); ICILS 2023 data.

figure_en.population: gap in home connectivity problems between students with 0–25 and 26+ books (Romania, maximum)

quote: that skills like the management of privacy settings
es: Según ICILS 2023, habilidades como la gestión de la configuración de privacidad se adquieren sobre todo fuera de la escuela; el alumnado de contextos desfavorecidos corre el riesgo de no desarrollarlas si no se enseñan explícitamente en el centro.
caveat: Autopercepción de estudiantes en ICILS; no mide el dominio real.
en: According to ICILS 2023, skills such as managing privacy settings are acquired mainly outside school; students from disadvantaged backgrounds risk not developing them if they are not explicitly taught at school.
caveat_en: Student self-perception in ICILS; does not measure actual proficiency.

quote: privacy settings for internet accounts and ICT devices
es: El texto señala que usar internet con seguridad exige evaluar información fiable, gestionar la privacidad de cuentas y dispositivos y usar redes sociales con cautela; la escuela es un lugar menos común que el entorno extraescolar para aprender a gestionar la privacidad (50 % o más lo reporta en 14 de 25 sistemas).
caveat: Autoinforme de estudiantes (ICILS 2023); 'in 14 out of 25 education systems only' en p. 125.

figure.population: sistemas donde 50 % o más del alumnado dice aprender en la escuela a gestionar la privacidad

en: The text notes that using the internet safely requires evaluating reliable information, managing account and device privacy, and using social media with caution; school is a less common setting than the out-of-school environment for learning to manage privacy (50% or more report it in 14 of 25 systems).
caveat_en: Student self-report (ICILS 2023); 'in 14 out of 25 education systems only' on p. 125.

figure_en.population: systems where 50% or more of students say they learn to manage privacy at school

quote: (c) valuing online safety, with an emphasis on reducing the risks associated with using AI;
es: El currículo croata de IA (piloto) incluye, dentro del uso seguro y responsable de la IA, valorar la seguridad en línea y reducir riesgos asociados a la IA; el mismo listado incluye reconocer y prevenir el ciberacoso y respetar los derechos de autor.
age_note: Dos currículos piloto: extracurricular para escuelas básicas y optativa para secundaria (niveles ISCED no precisados en el texto)
caveat: Proyecto piloto en Croacia; no evalúa resultados.
en: The Croatian AI curriculum (pilot) includes, within the safe and responsible use of AI, assessing online safety and reducing AI-related risks; the same list includes recognizing and preventing cyberbullying and respecting copyright.
caveat_en: Pilot project in Croatia; does not assess outcomes.
age_note_en: Two pilot curricula: extracurricular for basic schools and elective for secondary (ISCED levels not specified in the text)

quote: • Compare the solution provided by the AI system with their
es: En Chipre, los objetivos de tercer año incluyen formular prompts, evaluar y reformular resultados, usar la IA para resolver problemas y comparar críticamente la solución de la IA con la propia; en primer año se reconoce qué es un sistema de IA y se identifican ejemplos cotidianos.
caveat: Ejemplo de un país; evaluado dentro de la asignatura 'computing'.
en: In Cyprus, the third-year objectives include formulating prompts, evaluating and reformulating outputs, using AI to solve problems, and critically comparing the AI's solution with one's own; in the first year, students recognize what an AI system is and identify everyday examples.
caveat_en: Example from one country; assessed within the 'computing' subject.
age_note_en: ISCED 24 (lower secondary; focus of the report)

quote: The analysis of various examples of AI integration into
es: El análisis de ejemplos nacionales revela consenso en las competencias esenciales de IA: comprender las tecnologías de IA, reconocer beneficios y riesgos, poder usar e incluso diseñar estas tecnologías, y atender consideraciones de seguridad y ética.
caveat: Síntesis descriptiva de currículos nacionales; no es un estándar ni evalúa efectos.
en: The analysis of national examples reveals consensus on essential AI competences: understanding AI technologies, recognizing benefits and risks, being able to use and even design these technologies, and addressing safety and ethical considerations.
caveat_en: Descriptive synthesis of national curricula; it is not a standard and does not assess effects.
age_note_en: ISCED 24 (lower secondary; focus of the report)

quote: only seven countries include the safe and ethical
es: Solo siete sistemas (Chequia, Alemania, España, Francia, Letonia, Rumanía y Noruega) incluyen el uso seguro y ético de la IA en los marcos de competencias de la formación inicial docente.
caveat: Describe políticas nacionales (Eurydice, 38 sistemas); no evalúa efectos en estudiantes.

figure.population: sistemas con uso seguro y ético de la IA en marcos de formación inicial docente

en: Only seven systems (Czechia, Germany, Spain, France, Latvia, Romania and Norway) include the safe and ethical use of AI in the competence frameworks for initial teacher education.
caveat_en: Describes national policies (Eurydice, 38 systems); does not assess effects on students.

figure_en.population: systems with safe and ethical use of AI in initial teacher education frameworks

quote: the safe and ethical use of AI is mentioned in 15 systems
es: En los marcos de desarrollo profesional continuo, el uso seguro y ético de la IA figura en 15 sistemas, el doble que en la formación inicial.
caveat: Discrepancia interna: el resumen ejecutivo (p. 25) habla de 16 sistemas; usar cautela con la cifra exacta.

figure.population: sistemas con uso seguro y ético de IA en marcos CPD

en: In continuing professional development frameworks, the safe and ethical use of AI appears in 15 systems, double the number for initial education.
caveat_en: Internal discrepancy: the executive summary (p. 25) mentions 16 systems; use caution with the exact figure.

figure_en.population: systems with safe and ethical use of AI in CPD frameworks

quote: an average of only 29 % of lower-secondary teachers in 22 EU countries
es: Según TALIS 2024, solo un 29 % de docentes de secundaria baja (media de 22 países UE) participó en el último año en formación sobre uso de IA para enseñar; el 75 % no percibe una necesidad alta y el 53 % no participó en formación.
caveat: Encuesta TALIS 2024 a docentes; autoinforme.

figure.population: docentes de secundaria baja con CPD en IA en los 12 meses previos
figure.n_or_base: promedio de 22 países de la UE (TALIS 2024)

en: According to TALIS 2024, only 29% of lower secondary teachers (average of 22 EU countries) took part in training on using AI for teaching in the past year; 75% do not perceive a high need and 53% did not take part in training.
caveat_en: TALIS 2024 teacher survey; self-report.

figure_en.population: lower secondary teachers with CPD on AI in the previous 12 months

quote: Only 25 % of teachers declared a high need for developing skills for using AI for teaching and learning, but only 7 % also participated in related CPD.
es: Solo el 25 % de docentes declaró una necesidad alta de desarrollar competencias en IA y apenas el 7 % de ellos además participó en formación relacionada (TALIS 2024).
caveat: Encuesta TALIS 2024; el 7 % se refiere al total de docentes con necesidad alta y participación.

figure.population: docentes con necesidad alta de formación en IA y que además participaron en CPD
figure.n_or_base: promedio de 22 países de la UE (TALIS 2024)

en: Only 25% of teachers reported a high need to develop AI competences, and barely 7% of them also took part in related training (TALIS 2024).
caveat_en: TALIS 2024 survey; the 7% refers to the total of teachers with a high need and participation.

figure_en.population: teachers with a high need for AI training who also took part in CPD

quote: and effective use of AI in teaching and learning, with such guidelines already adopted in more than half of the education systems.
es: Los sistemas desarrollan cada vez más lineamientos sobre el uso responsable y eficaz de la IA en la enseñanza; ya existen en más de la mitad de los sistemas. Los docentes reconocen beneficios de lo digital, pero son más escépticos sobre los beneficios educativos de la IA (TALIS).
caveat: Describe políticas nacionales (Eurydice, 38 sistemas); no evalúa efectos en estudiantes.
en: Systems are increasingly developing guidelines on the responsible and effective use of AI in teaching; they already exist in more than half of the systems. Teachers recognize the benefits of digital technology but are more skeptical about the educational benefits of AI (TALIS).
caveat_en: Describes national policies (Eurydice, 38 systems); does not assess effects on students.
age_note_en: ISCED 24 (lower secondary; focus of the report)

quote: and effective use of AI are reported in 22 education
es: Se reportan lineamientos para docentes sobre uso responsable y eficaz de la IA en 22 sistemas educativos; suelen abordar comprensión de la lógica de la IA, evaluación crítica de contenidos generados, protección de datos y derechos de autor, y apoyo a un uso responsable por parte del alumnado.
caveat: Describe políticas nacionales (Eurydice, 38 sistemas); no evalúa efectos en estudiantes.

figure.population: sistemas con lineamientos docentes sobre uso de IA

en: Guidelines for teachers on the responsible and effective use of AI are reported in 22 education systems; they usually address understanding the logic of AI, critical evaluation of generated content, data protection and copyright, and support for responsible use by students.
caveat_en: Describes national policies (Eurydice, 38 systems); does not assess effects on students.
age_note_en: ISCED 24 (lower secondary; focus of the report)

figure_en.population: systems with teacher guidelines on AI use

quote: The national plan provides a framework for introducing AI-related learning and for promoting the safe and responsible use of AI tools across education levels during 2025–2027.
es: Eslovaquia adoptó en septiembre de 2025 un plan para el uso responsable de la IA en educación (2025–2027), con un marco para introducir aprendizaje sobre IA y promover el uso seguro y responsable de herramientas de IA en todos los niveles.
age_note: 'across education levels' (niveles no desglosados en el texto)
caveat: Adoptado después del periodo de referencia (2024/2025); describe un plan, no evalúa efectos.
en: Slovakia adopted in September 2025 a plan for the responsible use of AI in education (2025–2027), with a framework to introduce learning about AI and promote the safe and responsible use of AI tools at all levels.
caveat_en: Adopted after the reference period (2024/2025); describes a plan, does not assess effects.
age_note_en: 'across education levels' (levels not broken down in the text)

quote: Figure 1.13 shows that 24 education systems report
es: 24 de los 38 sistemas reportan al menos un marco de política de alto nivel sobre integración de la IA u otras tecnologías emergentes en las escuelas, casi siempre dentro de estrategias digitales más amplias o guías, no en marcos específicos de IA.
caveat: Describe políticas nacionales (Eurydice, 38 sistemas); no evalúa efectos en estudiantes.

figure.population: sistemas con marco de alto nivel sobre IA/tecnologías emergentes

en: 24 of the 38 systems report at least one high-level policy framework on integrating AI or other emerging technologies in schools, almost always within broader digital strategies or guidelines rather than AI-specific frameworks.
caveat_en: Describes national policies (Eurydice, 38 systems); does not assess effects on students.
age_note_en: ISCED 24 (lower secondary; focus of the report)

figure_en.population: systems with a high-level framework on AI/emerging technologies

quote: Research similarly underlines that, without clear frameworks, AI adoption may deepen inequalities
es: El informe cita literatura según la cual, sin marcos claros, la adopción de la IA puede profundizar las desigualdades; organismos internacionales piden tecnologías centradas en las personas y alineadas con los derechos de la infancia, con transparencia y no discriminación.
caveat: Cita literatura secundaria (Schellekens y Skilling, 2024; Varsik y Vosberg, 2024); no es evidencia propia del informe.
en: The report cites literature according to which, without clear frameworks, the adoption of AI may deepen inequalities; international organizations call for people-centered technologies aligned with children's rights, with transparency and non-discrimination.
caveat_en: Cites secondary literature (Schellekens and Skilling, 2024; Varsik and Vosberg, 2024); it is not the report's own evidence.
age_note_en: ISCED 24 (lower secondary; focus of the report)

quote: related to transparency and safety. Its implementation is also likely to require continued guidance and
es: La Ley de IA de la UE introduce un marco regulatorio basado en riesgo aplicable a usos educativos de la IA, complementa el RGPD y refuerza obligaciones de transparencia y seguridad; su aplicación requerirá orientación y desarrollo de capacidades en las escuelas.
caveat: Descripción del marco regulatorio de la UE; no analiza cumplimiento.
en: The EU AI Act introduces a risk-based regulatory framework applicable to educational uses of AI, complements the GDPR and reinforces transparency and safety obligations; its implementation will require guidance and capacity-building in schools.
caveat_en: Description of the EU regulatory framework; does not analyze compliance.
age_note_en: ISCED 24 (lower secondary; focus of the report)

quote: 21 refer explicitly to ethical use and data protection.
es: De los 24 sistemas con marcos sobre IA, 21 mencionan explícitamente el uso ético y la protección de datos; sin embargo, en la mayoría la gobernanza ética se articula mediante guías y principios, más que por requisitos procedimentales vinculantes.
caveat: Describe políticas nacionales (Eurydice, 38 sistemas); no evalúa efectos en estudiantes.

figure.population: sistemas con marco de IA que mencionan ética y protección de datos

en: Of the 24 systems with AI frameworks, 21 explicitly mention ethical use and data protection; however, in most, ethical governance is articulated through guidelines and principles rather than binding procedural requirements.
caveat_en: Describes national policies (Eurydice, 38 systems); does not assess effects on students.
age_note_en: ISCED 24 (lower secondary; focus of the report)

figure_en.population: systems with an AI framework that mention ethics and data protection

quote: in tailored versions for teachers, school leaders, students
es: Chequia emite recomendaciones sobre IA para escuelas básicas y secundarias superiores en versiones adaptadas para docentes, directivos, estudiantes y familias.
age_note: 'basic and upper-secondary schools' (educación básica ISCED 1–2 en Chequia y secundaria alta)
caveat: Describe políticas nacionales (Eurydice, 38 sistemas); no evalúa efectos en estudiantes.
en: Czechia issues recommendations on AI for basic and upper secondary schools in versions adapted for teachers, school leaders, students and families.
caveat_en: Describes national policies (Eurydice, 38 systems); does not assess effects on students.
age_note_en: 'basic and upper-secondary schools' (basic education ISCED 1–2 in Czechia, and upper secondary)

quote: evaluation of AI outputs, ethical awareness and age-
es: El marco checo promueve la experimentación pedagógica responsable con IA, subrayando la evaluación crítica de sus resultados, la conciencia ética y el uso apropiado a la edad (age-appropriate use).
age_note: 'basic and upper-secondary schools' (niveles ISCED no precisados)
caveat: Documento no vinculante de un país; el texto no detalla qué significa 'apropiado a la edad'.
en: The Czech framework promotes responsible pedagogical experimentation with AI, stressing critical evaluation of its outputs, ethical awareness and age-appropriate use.
caveat_en: Non-binding document from one country; the text does not detail what 'age-appropriate' means.
age_note_en: 'basic and upper-secondary schools' (ISCED levels not specified)

quote: adopted legislation on 5 March 2026 introducing mobile-phone-free schools and mobile-phone-free after-school centres.
es: Islandia adoptó el 5 de marzo de 2026 una ley que crea escuelas y centros extraescolares sin teléfonos móviles; Suecia propone una prohibición nacional en escuelas obligatorias (los alumnos entregarían el móvil toda la jornada).
age_note: Escuelas obligatorias (compulsory); niveles ISCED no precisados
caveat: Posterior al periodo de referencia (2024/2025); la propuesta sueca no estaba aprobada.
en: Iceland adopted on 5 March 2026 a law creating mobile-phone-free schools and after-school centers; Sweden proposes a national ban in compulsory schools (pupils would hand in their phones for the whole school day).
caveat_en: After the reference period (2024/2025); the Swedish proposal had not been approved.
age_note_en: Compulsory schools; ISCED levels not specified

quote: for regulating digital device use, while the remaining
es: Los 38 sistemas reportan requisitos o lineamientos sobre uso de dispositivos digitales en la escuela: 25 con requisitos obligatorios y 13 con guía no vinculante o delegación en escuelas o regiones.
caveat: Describe políticas nacionales (Eurydice, 38 sistemas); no evalúa efectos en estudiantes. Cita parcial: las cifras 38/25/13 están en la p. 93 pero el texto está intercalado por maquetación a dos columnas.

en: All 38 systems report requirements or guidelines on the use of digital devices at school: 25 with mandatory requirements and 13 with non-binding guidance or delegation to schools or regions.
caveat_en: Describes national policies (Eurydice, 38 systems); does not assess effects on students. Partial quotation: the figures 38/25/13 are on p. 93, but the text is interleaved because of the two-column layout.
age_note_en: ISCED 24 (lower secondary; focus of the report)

figure_en.unit: systems with mandatory requirements (13 with non-binding guidance)

quote: distraction linked to mobile phone use, while the
es: La preocupación por el uso no educativo de dispositivos sobre la atención, el bienestar y el aprendizaje, y la distracción en clase por el móvil, motiva restricciones; EU/OCDE subrayan que sus efectos dependen de cómo se implementan e integran en la cultura escolar y la pedagogía.
caveat: Evidencia secundaria citada (Nett 2025; Goodyear et al. 2025); el informe no mide efectos.
en: Concern about non-educational use of devices and its impact on attention, well-being and learning, and about phone-related distraction in class, motivates restrictions; the EU/OECD stress that their effects depend on how they are implemented and integrated into school culture and pedagogy.
caveat_en: Secondary evidence cited (Nett 2025; Goodyear et al. 2025); the report does not measure effects.
age_note_en: ISCED 24 (lower secondary; focus of the report)

quote: prohibits the use of mobile phones during classes in
es: Rumanía prohíbe el uso de móviles durante las clases en educación preescolar, primaria y secundaria baja, salvo fines educativos autorizados por el docente; las escuelas pueden ampliar la restricción.
caveat: Describe políticas nacionales (Eurydice, 38 sistemas); no evalúa efectos en estudiantes.
en: Romania prohibits the use of mobile phones during lessons in preschool, primary and lower secondary education, except for educational purposes authorized by the teacher; schools may extend the restriction.
caveat_en: Describes national policies (Eurydice, 38 systems); does not assess effects on students.

quote: banned in all basic schools, and secondary schools are required
es: Luxemburgo prohíbe los smartphones en todas las escuelas básicas y exige a las secundarias estrategias de separación física entre estudiantes y teléfonos durante las clases; la iniciativa incluye guías para familias y promueve el equilibrio pantalla-vida y el uso responsable de la IA.
caveat: Describe políticas nacionales (Eurydice, 38 sistemas); no evalúa efectos en estudiantes.
en: Luxembourg bans smartphones in all basic schools and requires secondary schools to adopt strategies for physically separating students from phones during lessons; the initiative includes guides for families and promotes screen-life balance and the responsible use of AI.
caveat_en: Describes national policies (Eurydice, 38 systems); does not assess effects on students.

quote: devices during lessons in primary, secondary and special
es: Países Bajos aplica desde 2024 un acuerdo nacional (no legislativo) que restringe móviles y otros dispositivos personales durante las clases en primaria, secundaria y educación especial; las escuelas definen los detalles con docentes, estudiantes y familias.
age_note: primary, secondary and special education (sin desglose ISCED)
caveat: Describe políticas nacionales (Eurydice, 38 sistemas); no evalúa efectos en estudiantes.
en: The Netherlands has applied since 2024 a national (non-legislative) agreement restricting mobile phones and other personal devices during lessons in primary, secondary and special education; schools define the details with teachers, students and families.
caveat_en: Describes national policies (Eurydice, 38 systems); does not assess effects on students.
age_note_en: primary, secondary and special education (no ISCED breakdown)

caveat: Describe políticas nacionales (Eurydice, 38 sistemas); no evalúa efectos en estudiantes.

quote: We will publish KCSIE (final version) 2026 on 1 September 2026.

quote: Schools and colleges in England must have regard to it when carrying out their duties to safeguard and promote the welfare of children.
es: Las escuelas y colegios de Inglaterra deben tener en cuenta esta guía al cumplir sus deberes de proteger y promover el bienestar de la niñez.
caveat: Marco de Inglaterra; no aplicable directamente a Costa Rica.
legal_status: guía estatutaria Inglaterra (en vigor desde 1 sep 2026; borrador 'for information only')
en: Schools and colleges in England must have regard to this guidance when carrying out their duties to safeguard and promote the welfare of children.
caveat_en: England framework; not directly applicable to Costa Rica.
legal_status_en: England statutory guidance (in force from 1 Sep 2026; draft 'for information only')

quote: For the purposes of this guidance children means everyone under the age of 18.
es: A efectos de la guía, 'niños' son todas las personas menores de 18 años.
caveat: Marco de Inglaterra; no aplicable directamente a Costa Rica.
legal_status: guía estatutaria Inglaterra (en vigor desde 1 sep 2026; borrador 'for information only')
en: For the purposes of the guidance, 'children' means all persons under 18 years of age.
caveat_en: England framework; not directly applicable to Costa Rica.
legal_status_en: England statutory guidance (in force from 1 Sep 2026; draft 'for information only')

quote: We use the term “must” when the person in question is legally required to do something, and “should” when the advice set out should be followed unless there is good reason not to.
es: La guía distingue 'must' (obligación legal) de 'should' (consejo a seguir salvo buena razón para no hacerlo); es clave para leer los deberes sobre IA.
caveat: Marco de Inglaterra; no aplicable directamente a Costa Rica.
legal_status: guía estatutaria Inglaterra (en vigor desde 1 sep 2026; borrador 'for information only')
en: The guidance distinguishes 'must' (a legal obligation) from 'should' (advice to be followed unless there is good reason not to); this is key to reading the duties on AI.
caveat_en: England framework; not directly applicable to Costa Rica.
legal_status_en: England statutory guidance (in force from 1 Sep 2026; draft 'for information only')

quote: They may also be digitally altered or wholly generated using artificial intelligence, including what are sometimes described as ‘deepfakes’ or ‘deep nudes’.
es: La guía aclara que las imágenes de desnudos o semidesnudos pueden estar alteradas digitalmente o generadas totalmente con IA (deepfakes, 'deep nudes').
age_note: Aplica a menores de 18; mayor relevancia práctica en secundaria.
caveat: Marco de Inglaterra; no aplicable directamente a Costa Rica.
legal_status: guía estatutaria Inglaterra (en vigor desde 1 sep 2026; borrador 'for information only')
en: The guidance clarifies that nude or semi-nude images may be digitally altered or entirely generated with AI (deepfakes, 'deep nudes').
caveat_en: England framework; not directly applicable to Costa Rica.
age_note_en: Applies to persons under 18; greater practical relevance in secondary school.
legal_status_en: England statutory guidance (in force from 1 Sep 2026; draft 'for information only')

quote: Taking and sharing nude photographs including those generated using AI of those aged under 18 is a criminal offence.
es: Tomar y compartir fotografías de desnudos de menores de 18, incluidas las generadas con IA, es delito (nota al pie de la guía).
caveat: Marco de Inglaterra; no aplicable directamente a Costa Rica.
legal_status: guía estatutaria Inglaterra (en vigor desde 1 sep 2026; borrador 'for information only')
en: Taking and sharing nude photographs of persons under 18, including those generated with AI, is a criminal offence (guidance footnote).
caveat_en: England framework; not directly applicable to Costa Rica.
legal_status_en: England statutory guidance (in force from 1 Sep 2026; draft 'for information only')

quote: Consensual image sharing, especially between older children of the same age, may require a different response. It might not be abusive – but children still need to know it is illegal
es: Entre menores mayores de edad similar, el intercambio consentido puede requerir otra respuesta y no ser abusivo, pero debe enseñarse que es ilegal; el no consentido es ilegal y abusivo.
caveat: Marco de Inglaterra; no aplicable directamente a Costa Rica.
legal_status: guía estatutaria Inglaterra (en vigor desde 1 sep 2026; borrador 'for information only')
en: Among children of a similar age, consensual sharing may require a different response and may not be abusive, but it must be taught that it is illegal; non-consensual sharing is illegal and abusive.
caveat_en: England framework; not directly applicable to Costa Rica.
legal_status_en: England statutory guidance (in force from 1 Sep 2026; draft 'for information only')

quote: All staff should be aware that technology is a significant component in many safeguarding and wellbeing issues. Children are at risk of abuse and other risks online as well as face to face.
es: Todo el personal debe saber que la tecnología es un componente importante de muchos problemas de protección y bienestar, y que el riesgo en línea suele darse junto al presencial.
caveat: Marco de Inglaterra; no aplicable directamente a Costa Rica.
legal_status: guía estatutaria Inglaterra (en vigor desde 1 sep 2026; borrador 'for information only')
en: All staff must know that technology is an important component of many safeguarding and wellbeing problems, and that online risk often occurs alongside in-person risk.
caveat_en: England framework; not directly applicable to Costa Rica.
legal_status_en: England statutory guidance (in force from 1 Sep 2026; draft 'for information only')

quote: Children can also abuse other children online, this can take the form of abusive, harassing, and misogynistic/misandrist messages
es: Los menores también pueden abusar de otros menores en línea mediante mensajes abusivos, acosadores y misóginos/misándricos.
caveat: Marco de Inglaterra; no aplicable directamente a Costa Rica.
legal_status: guía estatutaria Inglaterra (en vigor desde 1 sep 2026; borrador 'for information only')
en: Children can also abuse other children online through abusive, harassing and misogynistic/misandrist messages.
caveat_en: England framework; not directly applicable to Costa Rica.
legal_status_en: England statutory guidance (in force from 1 Sep 2026; draft 'for information only')

quote: being exposed to illegal, inappropriate, or harmful content, for example: pornography, racism, misogyny, self-harm, suicide, antisemitism, radicalisation, extremism, extreme sexual or physical violence, misinformation, disinformation (including fake news) and conspiracy theories
es: Primer riesgo de las '4 C': contenido (ilegal, inapropiado o dañino, incluida desinformación y teorías conspirativas).
caveat: Marco de Inglaterra; no aplicable directamente a Costa Rica.
legal_status: guía estatutaria Inglaterra (en vigor desde 1 sep 2026; borrador 'for information only')
en: First risk of the '4 Cs': content (illegal, inappropriate or harmful, including misinformation and conspiracy theories).
caveat_en: England framework; not directly applicable to Costa Rica.
legal_status_en: England statutory guidance (in force from 1 Sep 2026; draft 'for information only')

quote: being subjected to harmful online interaction with other users or generative AI applications that simulate this
es: La categoría 'contacto' incluye interacciones dañinas con otros usuarios o con aplicaciones de IA generativa que las simulan.
caveat: Marco de Inglaterra; no aplicable directamente a Costa Rica.
legal_status: guía estatutaria Inglaterra (en vigor desde 1 sep 2026; borrador 'for information only')
en: The 'contact' category includes harmful interactions with other users or with generative AI applications that simulate them.
caveat_en: England framework; not directly applicable to Costa Rica.
legal_status_en: England statutory guidance (in force from 1 Sep 2026; draft 'for information only')

quote: making, sending and receiving explicit images, including those generated using AI and online bullying
es: La categoría 'conducta' incluye hacer, enviar y recibir imágenes explícitas, también las generadas con IA, y el acoso en línea.
caveat: Marco de Inglaterra; no aplicable directamente a Costa Rica.
legal_status: guía estatutaria Inglaterra (en vigor desde 1 sep 2026; borrador 'for information only')
en: The 'conduct' category includes making, sending and receiving explicit images, including those generated with AI, and online harassment.
caveat_en: England framework; not directly applicable to Costa Rica.
legal_status_en: England statutory guidance (in force from 1 Sep 2026; draft 'for information only')

quote: risks such as online gambling, inappropriate advertising, phishing and or financial scams
es: La categoría 'comercio' abarca apuestas en línea, publicidad inapropiada, phishing y estafas financieras.
caveat: Marco de Inglaterra; no aplicable directamente a Costa Rica.
legal_status: guía estatutaria Inglaterra (en vigor desde 1 sep 2026; borrador 'for information only')
en: The 'commerce' category covers online gambling, inappropriate advertising, phishing and financial scams.
caveat_en: England framework; not directly applicable to Costa Rica.
legal_status_en: England statutory guidance (in force from 1 Sep 2026; draft 'for information only')

quote: Guidance to support schools and colleges to understand safety considerations and legal responsibilities if they choose to use Generative AI (either teacher-facing or pupil-facing) can be found at Generative artificial intelligence in education.
es: Si el centro decide usar IA generativa (para docentes o alumnado), debe consultar la guía específica del DfE sobre consideraciones de seguridad y responsabilidades legales; usar IA es opcional.
caveat: Marco de Inglaterra; no aplicable directamente a Costa Rica.
legal_status: guía estatutaria Inglaterra (en vigor desde 1 sep 2026; borrador 'for information only')

caveat_en: England framework; not directly applicable to Costa Rica.
legal_status_en: England statutory guidance (in force from 1 Sep 2026; draft 'for information only')

quote: Module 3 provides important information on identifying and mitigating key risks associated with safeguarding, ethics, data protection, and intellectual property.
es: Un recurso del DfE para el personal (módulo 3) cubre cómo identificar y mitigar riesgos de IA en protección, ética, protección de datos y propiedad intelectual.
caveat: Marco de Inglaterra; no aplicable directamente a Costa Rica.

caveat_en: England framework; not directly applicable to Costa Rica.
legal_status_en: England statutory guidance (in force from 1 Sep 2026; draft 'for information only')

quote: explains how filtering and monitoring requirements apply to the use of generative AI in education
es: El DfE publicó expectativas de seguridad de producto para IA generativa que explican cómo se aplican los requisitos de filtrado y monitoreo al uso de IA en educación.
caveat: Marco de Inglaterra; no aplicable directamente a Costa Rica.
legal_status: guía estatutaria Inglaterra (en vigor desde 1 sep 2026; borrador 'for information only')
en: The DfE published product safety expectations for generative AI that explain how filtering and monitoring requirements apply to the use of AI in education.
caveat_en: England framework; not directly applicable to Costa Rica.
legal_status_en: England statutory guidance (in force from 1 Sep 2026; draft 'for information only')

quote: governing bodies and proprietors should ensure their school or college has appropriate filtering and monitoring systems in place and ensure that a review of their effectiveness is carried out at least once every academic year
es: Los órganos de gobierno deben asegurar sistemas apropiados de filtrado y monitoreo y revisar su eficacia al menos una vez por año académico.
caveat: Marco de Inglaterra; no aplicable directamente a Costa Rica.
legal_status: guía estatutaria Inglaterra (en vigor desde 1 sep 2026; borrador 'for information only')
en: Governing bodies must ensure appropriate filtering and monitoring systems are in place and review their effectiveness at least once per academic year.
caveat_en: England framework; not directly applicable to Costa Rica.
legal_status_en: England statutory guidance (in force from 1 Sep 2026; draft 'for information only')

quote: block harmful and inappropriate content without unreasonably impacting teaching and learning
es: Los estándares piden bloquear contenido dañino sin afectar de forma irrazonable la enseñanza y el aprendizaje.
caveat: Marco de Inglaterra; no aplicable directamente a Costa Rica.
legal_status: guía estatutaria Inglaterra (en vigor desde 1 sep 2026; borrador 'for information only')
en: The standards call for blocking harmful content without unreasonably affecting teaching and learning.
caveat_en: England framework; not directly applicable to Costa Rica.
legal_status_en: England statutory guidance (in force from 1 Sep 2026; draft 'for information only')

quote: they should be careful that “over blocking” does not lead to unreasonable restrictions as to what children can be taught with regard to online teaching and safeguarding
es: Se advierte que el exceso de bloqueo no debe restringir de forma irrazonable lo que se puede enseñar sobre seguridad en línea.
caveat: Marco de Inglaterra; no aplicable directamente a Costa Rica.
legal_status: guía estatutaria Inglaterra (en vigor desde 1 sep 2026; borrador 'for information only')
en: It is cautioned that over-blocking must not unreasonably restrict what can be taught about online safety.
caveat_en: England framework; not directly applicable to Costa Rica.
legal_status_en: England statutory guidance (in force from 1 Sep 2026; draft 'for information only')

quote: The designated safeguarding lead should take lead responsibility for safeguarding and child protection (including online safety and understanding the filtering and monitoring systems and processes in place).
es: El responsable designado de protección (DSL) lidera la protección infantil, incluida la seguridad en línea y el conocimiento de los sistemas de filtrado y monitoreo; debe constar en su descripción de puesto.

caveat_en: England framework; not directly applicable to Costa Rica.
legal_status_en: England statutory guidance (in force from 1 Sep 2026; draft 'for information only')

quote: all staff undergo safeguarding and child protection training (including online safety which, amongst other things, includes an understanding of the expectations, applicable roles and responsibilities in relation to filtering and monitoring
es: Todo el personal debe recibir formación en protección infantil que incluya seguridad en línea y los roles sobre filtrado y monitoreo.

legal_status: guía estatutaria Inglaterra (en vigor desde 1 sep 2026; borrador 'for information only')

caveat_en: England framework; not directly applicable to Costa Rica.

quote: all staff should receive safeguarding and child protection (including online safety) updates (for example, via email, e-bulletins, and staff meetings), as required, and at least annually
es: Todo el personal debe recibir actualizaciones de protección (incluida seguridad en línea) según se requiera y al menos una vez al año.

legal_status_en: England statutory guidance (in force from 1 Sep 2026; draft 'for information only')

quote: understanding online harms such as sharing images, the prevalence of deepfakes, pornography and misogynistic influencers and when and where to seek help
es: El programa de educación en relaciones, sexualidad y salud (RSHE) debe enseñar daños en línea como compartir imágenes, deepfakes, pornografía e influenciadores misóginos, y dónde buscar ayuda.
age_note: La guía pide un programa 'age and stage of development appropriate'; no fija tramos por edad.

legal_status: guía estatutaria Inglaterra (en vigor desde 1 sep 2026; borrador 'for information only')
en: The relationships, sex and health education (RSHE) programme should teach online harms such as image sharing, deepfakes, pornography and misogynistic influencers, and where to seek help.
caveat_en: England framework; not directly applicable to Costa Rica.
age_note_en: The guidance calls for a programme that is 'age and stage of development appropriate'; it does not set age bands.
legal_status_en: England statutory guidance (in force from 1 Sep 2026; draft 'for information only')

quote: It will be especially important for parents and carers to be aware of what their children are being asked to do online, including the sites they will be asked to access
es: Los centros deben comunicar a las familias qué se pide hacer en línea al alumnado, qué sitios usará y quién del centro interactuará con él.

caveat_en: England framework; not directly applicable to Costa Rica.

quote: Governing bodies and proprietors should take measures to safeguard children by protecting personal information and ensuring their school or college has appropriate cyber security systems in place.
es: Los órganos de gobierno deben proteger la información personal del alumnado y contar con sistemas de ciberseguridad apropiados, como parte de la protección infantil.

en: Governing bodies should protect pupils' personal information and have appropriate cybersecurity systems in place, as part of safeguarding.
caveat_en: England framework; not directly applicable to Costa Rica.
legal_status_en: England statutory guidance (in force from 1 Sep 2026; draft 'for information only')

quote: All schools should be mobile phone-free environments by default; anything other than this should be by exception only.
es: Las escuelas deben ser entornos libres de teléfono móvil por defecto; cualquier otra situación solo por excepción.

caveat: Marco de Inglaterra; no aplicable directamente a Costa Rica.
legal_status: guía estatutaria Inglaterra (en vigor desde 1 sep 2026; borrador 'for information only')
en: Schools should be mobile-phone-free environments by default; any other situation only by exception.
caveat_en: England framework; not directly applicable to Costa Rica.
age_note_en: The text refers to 'schools' in general, without distinguishing ages.
legal_status_en: England statutory guidance (in force from 1 Sep 2026; draft 'for information only')

quote: consensual and non-consensual making or sharing of nudes and semi- nudes, including those generated using AI
es: La política de protección frente al abuso entre pares debe cubrir el intercambio de desnudos y semidesnudos, consentido o no, incluidos los generados con IA.

en: The child-on-child abuse policy must cover the sharing of nude and semi-nude images, whether consensual or not, including those generated with AI.
caveat_en: England framework; not directly applicable to Costa Rica.
legal_status_en: England statutory guidance (in force from 1 Sep 2026; draft 'for information only')

quote: Child-on-child abuse is most likely to include, but may not be limited to: • bullying (including cyberbullying, prejudice-based and discriminatory bullying)
es: El abuso entre pares incluye, entre otras formas, el acoso, también el ciberacoso y el acoso discriminatorio.

en: Child-on-child abuse includes, among other forms, bullying, including cyberbullying and discriminatory bullying.

legal_status_en: England statutory guidance (in force from 1 Sep 2026; draft 'for information only')

quote: Understanding and responding to AI-generated child sexual abuse material: guidance from the National Crime Agency

quote: minors below the age of 13 should not have access to harmful online social networking services and video-sharing platform services
es: Se recomienda que menores de 13 años no accedan a redes sociales ni plataformas de video dañinas.

caveat_en: Legislative proposal, not adopted

quote: an AI system, including a general-purpose AI system, that provides sustained, personalised interaction or companionship which simulates or facilitates a social, emotional or interpersonal relationship with a user

legal_status: propuesta no adoptada
en: It defines an 'AI companion' as a system that offers sustained personalised interaction or companionship that simulates a social, emotional or interpersonal relationship.
caveat_en: Legislative proposal, not adopted
legal_status_en: proposal, not adopted

quote: avoiding design features and system behaviours that simulate interpersonal relations that are likely to create emotional dependencies
es: Los proveedores de compañeros de IA y chatbots conversacionales generales deben evitar diseños que simulen relaciones interpersonales y generen dependencia emocional en menores.
caveat: Propuesta legislativa, no adoptada
legal_status: propuesta no adoptada
en: Providers of AI companions and general conversational chatbots must avoid designs that simulate interpersonal relationships and generate emotional dependence in minors.
caveat_en: Legislative proposal, not adopted
legal_status_en: proposal, not adopted

quote: access to services and systems referred to in paragraph 1 for minors below the age of 13 years is only enabled and controlled by means of the tools for guardians

caveat: Propuesta legislativa, no adoptada
legal_status: propuesta no adoptada
en: Access by children under 13 to AI companions and chatbots may only be enabled and controlled through tools for guardians.
caveat_en: Legislative proposal, not adopted
legal_status_en: proposal, not adopted

quote: their system does not use information or analysis derived from a minor's prior interactions in subsequent interactions
es: Por defecto, el sistema no debe usar información derivada de interacciones previas del menor en interacciones posteriores, salvo para proteger su seguridad.
caveat: Propuesta legislativa, no adoptada
legal_status: propuesta no adoptada
en: By default, the system must not use information derived from a minor's previous interactions in subsequent interactions, except to protect their safety.
caveat_en: Legislative proposal, not adopted
legal_status_en: proposal, not adopted

quote: performing state-of-the art evaluations and testing of the system for risks to the health, safety and fundamental rights and the physical, mental and emotional well-being and development of minors
es: Antes de comercializarlo, el proveedor debe evaluar y probar el sistema en cuanto a riesgos para salud, seguridad, derechos y bienestar de menores.
caveat: Propuesta legislativa, no adoptada
legal_status: propuesta no adoptada
en: Before placing it on the market, the provider must assess and test the system for risks to the health, safety, rights and wellbeing of minors.
caveat_en: Legislative proposal, not adopted
legal_status_en: proposal, not adopted

quote: the AI companion or general conversational chatbot is not activated automatically
es: Si un compañero de IA o chatbot se integra en una red social, plataforma de video o juego, no puede activarse automáticamente, y el menor debe poder desactivarlo.
caveat: Propuesta legislativa, no adoptada
legal_status: propuesta no adoptada
en: If an AI companion or chatbot is integrated into a social network, video platform or game, it may not be activated automatically, and the minor must be able to deactivate it.
caveat_en: Legislative proposal, not adopted
legal_status_en: proposal, not adopted

quote: shall not design, organise or operate their services in a manner that is intended, or can reasonably be foreseen, to encourage compulsive or excessive use
es: Prohíbe diseñar redes sociales y plataformas de video para fomentar el uso compulsivo o excesivo por menores.
caveat: Propuesta legislativa, no adoptada
legal_status: propuesta no adoptada
en: It prohibits designing social media and video platforms to encourage compulsive or excessive use by minors.
caveat_en: Legislative proposal, not adopted
legal_status_en: proposal, not adopted

quote: Such measures shall be designed in a way that protects school time and core sleep hours of minors.
es: Las medidas de límite e interrupción del uso deben proteger el horario escolar y las horas de sueño del menor.
caveat: Propuesta legislativa, no adoptada
legal_status: propuesta no adoptada
en: Measures limiting and interrupting use must protect the minor's school hours and sleep hours.
caveat_en: Legislative proposal, not adopted
legal_status_en: proposal, not adopted

quote: disable by default the recommendation of information suggested by the recommender system based on implicit engagement-based signals from minors’ behaviour online
es: Los sistemas de recomendación deben desactivar por defecto las recomendaciones basadas en señales implícitas de comportamiento del menor.
caveat: Propuesta legislativa, no adoptada
legal_status: propuesta no adoptada
en: Recommender systems must disable by default recommendations based on implicit behavioural signals from the minor.
caveat_en: Legislative proposal, not adopted
legal_status_en: proposal, not adopted

quote: by default, turn off at least the following settings: (a) geolocation and other tracking features; (b) access to microphone and camera
es: Por defecto deben estar desactivadas la geolocalización, el rastreo y el acceso a micrófono y cámara para menores.
caveat: Propuesta legislativa, no adoptada
legal_status: propuesta no adoptada
en: Geolocation, tracking and access to the microphone and camera must be disabled by default for minors.
caveat_en: Legislative proposal, not adopted
legal_status_en: proposal, not adopted

quote: Age assurance solutions shall not enable the identification of the recipient nor locate, track, target, advertise to or profile recipients for any purpose.
es: La verificación de edad no debe permitir identificar, localizar, rastrear, dirigir publicidad ni perfilar al usuario.
caveat: Propuesta legislativa, no adoptada
legal_status: propuesta no adoptada
en: Age verification must not allow the user to be identified, located, tracked, targeted with advertising or profiled.
caveat_en: Legislative proposal, not adopted
legal_status_en: proposal, not adopted

quote: self-declaration is not sufficient for compliance with this Regulation
es: La mera autodeclaración de edad no basta para cumplir el Reglamento.

legal_status: propuesta no adoptada
en: Mere self-declaration of age is not sufficient to comply with the Regulation.
caveat_en: Legislative proposal, not adopted
legal_status_en: proposal, not adopted

quote: Non-compliance with those obligations shall be subject to administrative fines under Article 99 of Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 not exceeding 6 % of the total worldwide annual turnover
es: El incumplimiento por proveedores de compañeros de IA y chatbots puede sancionarse con multas de hasta 6 % del volumen de negocios mundial anual.
caveat: Propuesta legislativa, no adoptada
legal_status: propuesta no adoptada
en: Non-compliance by providers of AI companions and chatbots may be penalised with fines of up to 6 % of annual worldwide turnover.
caveat_en: Legislative proposal, not adopted
legal_status_en: proposal, not adopted

quote: This Regulation shall enter into force on the twentieth day following that of its publication in the Official Journal of the European Union.

quote: AI chatbots encouraging individuals, especially young or otherwise vulnerable people, to self-harm or suicide, or to acts of violence
es: El comité refiere reportes de chatbots que habrían animado a jóvenes u otras personas vulnerables a autolesionarse, al suicidio o a la violencia.
caveat: Informe de comité; reportes de casos, no estimación de prevalencia.
